newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo edges higher with crosses at close.
newsitem.headline: Escudo edges higher with crosses at close.

text.p: 1624 GMT - The escudo edged higher against the mark at the close, in line with the peseta and lira. Dealers said the market was keenly awaiting news of the stability pact at the EU leaders' summit in Amsterdam on Monday and Tuesday. They said confirmation that the euro was set to be launched on time could help the franc, peseta, lira and escudo to recover. The escudo closed at 101.14/17 per mark, compared with 101.19/22 at the opening.
